title: Program Days Requested on a Work Conditioning or Work Hardening Extension
content:
# Program days requested on an extension

**Clause 1.** An extension of the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program under a Workers' Compensation Referral requests the program's maximum program days per week for a two-week request window, less every authorized program day still unused on the referral.

**Clause 2.** The requested program days are worked out in this order: first the requested weekly frequency is multiplied by the request window in whole weeks, then the transition days and the discharge re-test days are added, then the netted unused days and the re-entry reduction are taken off, and the total is never below zero.

## Elements

| Element | Measure |
|---|---|
| Requested weekly frequency | the program's maximum program days per week |
| Request window | 2 weeks |
| Unused days | every authorized program day still unused on the referral |
| Floor | the requested program days are never below zero |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A program whose maximum is 5 program days per week, with 3 authorized program days still unused: 5 multiplied by 2 weeks is 10; less 3 unused days, 7 program days are requested.
- The same program with no unused days: 10 program days are requested.
- The same program with 12 unused days: 10 less 12 falls below zero, so 0 program days are requested.
